label: deal
eval: (()=>{const {game}=PTD.current; const p=game.human; p.deck.push({suit:2,rank:9},{suit:0,rank:13},{suit:1,rank:13},{suit:3,rank:13},{suit:2,rank:13}); let n=0; const used=[]; for(const s of p.spots){ if(used.some(u=>Math.hypot(u.x-s.x,u.y-s.y)<350)) continue; if(game.deal(p,s.x,s.y)){n++;used.push(s);} if(n>=5) break;} p.hand.slice(0,4).forEach(t=>t.selected=true); return p.hand.map(t=>t.title)})()

label: zoom
eval: (()=>{const {game,renderer}=PTD.current; const t=game.human.hand.find(t=>t.kind==='combo'); renderer.cam.x=t.x+200; renderer.cam.y=t.y-300; renderer.cam.zoom=0.42; return t.title})()

label: wave
eval: (()=>{const {game,renderer}=PTD.current; game.opts.allAI=true; game.human.human=false; for(let i=0;i<30*14;i++) game.update(1/30); const c=game.creeps.find(c=>c.alive&&c.owner===0); if(c){renderer.cam.x=c.x; renderer.cam.y=c.y-200; renderer.cam.zoom=0.3;} return {phase:game.phase, creeps:game.creeps.length}})()

label: boss
eval: (()=>{const {game,renderer}=PTD.current; let n=0; while(!(game.level===6&&game.phase==='spawn') && game.phase!=='over' && n<400000){game.update(1/30);n++} for(let i=0;i<30*3.5;i++) game.update(1/30); const b=game.creeps.find(c=>c.boss&&c.alive&&c.owner===0); if(b){renderer.cine=null; renderer.cam.x=b.x; renderer.cam.y=b.y-250; renderer.cam.zoom=0.55;} return !!b})()

label: fps
eval: (async()=>{let n=0; const t0=performance.now(); await new Promise(r=>{function f(){n++; if(performance.now()-t0<2000) requestAnimationFrame(f); else r();} requestAnimationFrame(f);}); return Math.round(n/2)+' fps (headless software GL), quality='+PTD.Renderer3D.quality})()
